examples.en: Friend, have you seen my red cow? I have not seen her. When did she go away? She went away in the night. Then look for her tracks near the river.

examples.pie: só h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m skinédt uh₁inéHt-kʷe séh₂ tā́m.
examples.en: He cut off the wool, and she twisted it.

examples.pie: séh₂ Hrésget só-kʷe uh₁inéHt.
examples.en: She was knitting, and he was winding.

examples.pie: h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m uh₁inHdʰí tónom tn̥nudʰí. gʷḗn h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m uh₁inéHti tónom tn̥néwti. gʷnéh₂s wókʷm̥ ḱléwsete kʷíd gʷḗn tḗtḱt tónom tḗtḱt?
examples.en: Twist the wool, stretch the string! The woman twists the wool, stretches the string. Listen to the woman's voice! What did the woman make? She made a string.

examples.pie: kʷíd kóslom ḱéleti wésmn̥-kʷe ne h₁ésti? só h₁iHn̥yós h₁ésti.
examples.en: What covers the hazel and is not a garment? It is hoarfrost.

examples.pie: h₁yós sḿ̥terosyo wésmn̥ kapyḗti só moysóm h₂éyos-kʷe déh₃eti.
examples.en: Whoever seizes the garment of one of the two shall give a ram and bronze.

examples.pie: kʷís wésmn̥ wéstor tód-kʷe ne kʷérm̥? só moysós h₁ésti.
examples.en: Who wears a garment, and I did not make it? It is the ram.

examples.pie: kʷértrom h₁ḗdsi? ne h₁ḗdmi. wékʷesh₂ h₁ḗdmi. túH sméytōr.
examples.en: Machine, do you eat? I do not eat. I eat words! You are a merry one!

examples.pie: nékʷti sési? ne sésmi. nékʷti Héh₂m̥ni-kʷe bʰéwdʰoh₂. ne ḱémh₂s? kʷértrom ne ḱémh₂t.
examples.en: Do you sleep at night? I do not sleep. I am awake by night and by day. Did you not grow tired? A machine does not grow tired.

examples.pie: kʷértrom me memónth₂e? príHe te ne memónh₂e. nu moy téwe wékʷesh₂ smr̥téy h₁ésti. smḗymi.
examples.en: Machine, do you remember me? I do not remember you, friend. Now your words are in my memory. I smile.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Instrument noun 'means of doing/making' from kʷer- 'do, make' with -trom (as h₂érh₃trom 'plough', Gk ἄροτρον; ǵʰéwtrom, ḱléwtrom 'ear'). Semantic model: Gk μηχανή 'contrivance', an instrument word of 'be able'.
